key.name: bootstrap-loaded-generation
key.summary: Internal bootstrap generation loaded by GNOME Shell

key.name: bootstrap-loaded-revision
key.summary: Internal bootstrap fingerprint loaded by GNOME Shell

key.name: runtime-loaded-revision
key.summary: Runtime revision currently loaded by the bootstrap

key.name: orb-icon
key.summary: Themed icon name or absolute SVG/PNG path used by the Orb

key.name: auto-hide-orb
key.summary: Slide the Orb to the nearest monitor edge while idle

key.name: auto-hide-delay
key.summary: Milliseconds before the idle Orb auto-hides

key.name: auto-fade-orb
key.summary: Fade the Orb while idle when auto-hide is disabled

key.name: auto-fade-delay
key.summary: Milliseconds before the idle Orb fades

key.name: orb-app-source
key.summary: Application source for the Orb radial launcher
key.description: Dock uses favorites plus running apps, Custom uses the selected desktop application IDs, and All uses every visible installed application.

key.name: orb-custom-apps
key.summary: Custom application IDs shown by the Orb
key.description: Ordered desktop application IDs used when Orb app source is Custom.

key.name: orb-geometry
key.summary: Geometry used by the Orb application launcher
key.description: Orbit preserves the classic circular launcher. Star, Molecule, Spiral and Petal use monitor-safe alternative slot generators while preserving the same application buttons and interactions.

key.name: icon-gap
key.summary: Minimum gap between Orb launcher icons

key.name: ring-gap
key.summary: Spacing between Orb launcher geometry levels

key.name: hover-delay
key.summary: Hover delay before the Orb radial launcher opens

key.name: close-delay
key.summary: Delay before the Orb radial launcher closes

key.name: show-tooltips
key.summary: Show application names around the Orb launcher

key.name: show-running-indicator
key.summary: Show running indicators on Orb launcher applications

key.name: app-preview-size
key.summary: Live Orb application preview size percentage

key.name: terminal-backdrop-blur-enabled
key.summary: Enable real compositor background blur beneath native Ptyxis windows
key.description: Off by default. GNOME Shell 50 adds a background-only GPU blur under matching Ptyxis surfaces. No other applications or text rendering are modified.

key.name: terminal-backdrop-blur-radius
key.description: GNOME Shell 50 uses Shell.BlurEffect.radius, which is twice the stored legacy sigma-equivalent strength. Stronger values increase GPU cost per terminal window.

key.name: terminal-backdrop-blur-status
key.summary: Read-only VLIQ Terminal Glass compositor attachment status
key.description: Written by the Shell runtime to report detected or attached Ptyxis windows. This is diagnostic text, not proof of visible blurred pixels.

key.name: spotlight-enabled
key.description: Shows the centered VLIQ application search with Super+Space.

key.name: spotlight-vertical-position
key.description: Search bar position as a percentage from the top of the active monitor.

key.name: quick-brightness-enabled
key.summary: Place a native-style Brightness slider immediately below Sound
key.description: Use the GNOME native brightness slider if available. Otherwise show a native-style software dimmer for external displays; no DDC access, no external binaries and no changes to monitor hardware.

key.name: quick-soft-brightness
key.summary: Software display brightness percentage for non-backlight monitors
key.description: 100 means unchanged and uses no extra GPU effect. Values below 100 apply bounded GPU software dimming to desktop windows; it cannot increase hardware brightness above the screen's current maximum.

key.name: quick-brightness-status
key.summary: Diagnostic status of the Quick Settings brightness control

key.name: panel-menu-hover-switch
key.summary: Switch between open panel menus on hover
key.description: When enabled, moving the pointer onto another panel menu source can switch to it after the configured dwell. When disabled, crossing panel icons does not open their menus; click and keyboard activation remain immediate.

key.name: panel-menu-hover-delay-ms
key.description: Milliseconds the pointer must continuously remain over another panel menu source before switching to it while a panel menu is already open.

key.name: dock-vertical-offset
key.description: Vertical paint offset in pixels. Positive values move the floating dock upward; negative values move it downward. Panel mode ignores this setting.

key.name: wallpaper-runtime-status
key.summary: Diagnostic status of attached Atmosphere wallpaper shader effects
key.description: Updated by the running GNOME Shell extension only; not a user setting. Reports source effects attached, not measured pixel output.

key.name: wallpaper-style
key.description: Original leaves GNOME wallpaper rendering unchanged. Other profiles apply static GPU-native visual grading to wallpaper sources.

key.name: glass-style
key.description: Liquid Glass preserves the v10 refractive material, while Frosted Crystal uses a matte-diffused surface with grain and soft edge light.

key.name: glass-optics-profile-version
key.summary: Internal VLIQ full-glass optics profile version

key.name: glass-opacity
key.summary: System Liquid Glass tint strength percentage

key.name: glass-filter-opacity
key.description: Low-opacity white veil painted above the refractive material and below native content.

key.name: date-menu-glass-opacity
key.description: Independent micro-tuning for the Date/Calendar popup.

key.name: date-menu-glass-blur
key.description: Independent low blur radius for a clearer refractive Date Menu.

key.name: date-menu-glass-filter-opacity
key.description: Neutral white veil for the Date/Calendar popup only.

key.name: glass-live-scene-fps
key.description: Caps expensive live window-clone synchronization while keeping Shell geometry and interaction on the native frame clock.
